description: This file contains unit tests for the RegistrationEventQueueDao class in the OrangeHRM Core Registration module. It tests fetching registration events by type, retrieving unpublished registration events, and saving new registration events.

classes.name: RegistrationEventQueueDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing RegistrationEventQueueDao operations such as fetching by type, retrieving unpublished events, and saving registration events.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by loading fixture data and initializing the DAO object.

methods.name: testGetRegistrationEventByType
methods.description: Tests retrieval of registration events by specified type and checks expected event IDs.

methods.name: testGetUnpublishedRegistrationEvents
methods.description: Tests retrieval of unpublished registration events with specified batch sizes and verifies event details.

methods.name: testSaveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Tests saving a new registration event and verifies stored data and type.
